# Provider log fixture provenance

All JSONL fixtures in this directory are synthetic. They contain invented IDs, timestamps, models, token counts, and message content. No fixture was copied from a user Provider home or local Provider log.

Format and semantics were checked on 2026-09-21 against these public sources:

- OpenAI Codex commit [`a86631502d49274cb47208925c7d3dcece032029`](https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/a86631502d49274cb47208925c7d3dcece032029): [`TokenUsage` and `TokenUsageInfo`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/a86631502d49274cb47208925c7d3dcece032029/codex-rs/tui/src/token_usage.rs) distinguish accumulated `total_token_usage` from `last_token_usage`; the [Responses usage parser test](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/a86631502d49274cb47208925c7d3dcece032029/codex-rs/codex-api/src/sse/responses.rs) confirms cached reads and cache writes are subdivisions of reported input; and the app-server rollout fixture shows the persisted `event_msg` / `token_count` envelope. The pinned source updates stored usage through `TokenUsageInfo::new_or_append`, while the public upstream report [#14489](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/14489) documents that rate-limit-only updates can re-emit the same stored `TokenUsageInfo`. The pinned [token usage replay tests](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/a86631502d49274cb47208925c7d3dcece032029/codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/token_usage_replay.rs) also construct valid `TokenCountEvent { info: None, ... }` values. The repository is Apache-2.0 licensed. The implementation here is independently written and does not copy upstream parser code.
- Anthropic's [Messages usage reference](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/typescript/messages), [prompt-caching documentation](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching), and public Claude Code issue [#4184](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/4184) show the assistant transcript envelope, explicit `sessionId`, `requestId`, `message.id`, and usage fields. Claude Code's repository is all-rights-reserved; no Claude Code source or parser implementation was copied.

Supported fixture profiles are deliberately narrow: Codex rollout `session_meta`, `turn_context`, and `event_msg` / `token_count` records; Claude Code `type: "assistant"` records with `message.usage`. Other well-formed records may coexist in a supported JSONL file, but a whole input with neither a supported usage record nor a valid `token_count` with `info: null` is rejected. Codex `token_count` has no request identity: cumulative totals remain provider-session ranges, while validated monotonic same-UTC-day differences can form dated intervals without model-request counts. Initial baselines and ambiguous cross-date increments remain unplaced. Standalone `last_token_usage` retains unknown scope; when a total is present, its last-usage companion is not emitted as a second unknown record. Neither line position, timestamp nor equal token values create model-request identity. A matching `task_complete` can seal the latest turn's cumulative observation; EOF alone cannot. Codex `token_usage_record`, selected/exported trace variants, filesystem discovery, rotation, checkpoints, and Provider-version auto-detection are outside this parser slice.
